hypothesis: Ordinary classification combines stable group preference with which context could change a decision. A conditional pairwise loss can learn the second component independently of a repeated profile's observed average response.
models: Infer recurring profile and context fields from training inputs. Train CatBoostRanker 1.2.10 PairLogit within automatically discovered profiles on raw fields plus the context token. Use 450 rounds, depth 6, learning rate .05, L2 3, seed 4291. Exclude constant-response groups from the pairwise objective. Estimate absolute acceptance with one ridge-logistic layer on centered rank, raw rank, smoothed profile and context rates and exposure counts, using only group-out-of-fit evidence for calibrator training. Three rank fits generate out-of-fold features, one refits on all fitting rows, and one trains the calibrator.
decision: Reuse the earlier fixed 4061 training rows, 808 nomination rows, then separate 817 / 807 checks. Compare fixed shares .125, .25, .5 and 1 against the established aligned-tree/raw-TabICL development reference. Break ties towards retaining the reference. No new validation/test scores. Five new supervised fits, no language model. Require no decline on either independent panel and a pooled increase of at least .003 to advance; a positive result must then face untouched new comparisons.
